subject: Pazuzu
text: Pazuzu puts his shield down after three or four turns, sometimes five, and when his shield is not up, use Flare and Aero to knock him on his behind.

evidence.quote:

turns, sometimes even five. He won't do anything while he has his shield up, so
that is a great time to cure. When his shield is not up, use Flare and Aero to
knock him on his behind.

subject: Dark King
text: For the normal way against Dark King, use Flare and White for 2 rounds, cure when he adds weapons to all his hands, continue Flare and White until he turns into a spider, then have Phoebe cure and Hero use Flare until he turns into an Octopus and dies.

evidence.quote:
Otherwise, you can do it the normal way. Use Flare and
White for 2 rounds. He will add weapons to all his hands. Cure, and keep cured.
Use refreshers and seeds if you need to. Then, keep on using Flare and White. He
will soon turn into a spider. Have Phoebe cure every round, while the Hero uses
Flare. He will then turn into an Octopus. Have Phoebe keep on curing, while the
Hero keeps using Flare, and he will soon die.
